notes.title: Weather update #1
notes.content: This update added procedural generated clouds and of course a bunch of bug fixes.  More weather updates coming in the future!

tags.feature: This update added procedural generated clouds

tags.bug: and of course a bunch of bug fixes.

notes.content: Fixed multiple smaller bugs and finished implementing the settings that allow for locking the camera behind the plane and taking manual control of the plane.  If you have played the game on controller I highly suggest giving it a try with this new setting!

tags.feature: finished implementing the settings that allow for locking the camera behind the plane and taking manual control of the plane.

notes.title: F-104 patch
notes.content: This patch includes fixes to the F-104 and a new auto assisting targeting system that should make it easier to aim when you get near an enemy.  If any bugs are found please join the discord and report them :)

tags.feature: a new auto assisting targeting system that should make it easier to aim when you get near an enemy.
